READ-ONLY AUDIT. Do not edit, create, commit or delete any file in treams-rs; do not run builds or tests. Read code only.

Repository: treams-rs, Python package python/treams_rs (treams-rs mirrors the numerical conventions of upstream treams).

Binding rule: the "Writing style" section of decisions.md (read it in full first; grep -n 'Writing style' -A60). Summary: simple, objective, approachable; Strunk (omit needless words, active voice, positive form, concrete language, short sentences); no meta commentary (nothing about the docs themselves, plans, reviews, packages, the code's history: 'previously', 'now', 'new', 'improved'); banned jargon words in user-facing text: contract, gate, harness, lane, campaign, canonical, semantics, surface (for an API), boundary (for an interface), leverage, utilize, facilitate, orchestrate, ergonomic, first-class; 'invariant' is fine only for a physical/mathematical invariant; unavoidable technical terms (pullback, cotangent, residual, VJP, Ewald split, helicity, Bloch vector) must be defined in plain words at first use on a page; code comments say why, not what. Also plan.md §4.1 has the plain definition of records (plan.md, grep -n '4.1' -A8).

YOUR SLICE: docstrings and comments in python/treams_rs/**/*.py and python/treams_rs/_native.pyi (these render into the public API reference). Find:

  1. banned jargon words (grep case-insensitively, then read context; exclude physics uses such as 'extended boundary condition', 'surface integral', 'surface element', and the word inside code identifiers you cannot rename);
  2. meta commentary and history wording (previously, now, new, old, formerly, used to, was renamed, this module/page explains, note that, as described above, round, lane, package, review);
  3. undefined technical abbreviations: 'VJP' (count occurrences per file), 'JVP', 'residual' without definition, 'cotangent' undefined at first use in a module docstring;
  4. passive or vague sentences only where they are clearly worse than an obvious active rewrite (be selective; at most ~15 of these);
  5. Sphinx roles (:meth:, :class:, :func:) in docstrings that render raw in the Markdown reference.

Owner map (first match wins):

  • python/treams_rs/{special,coeffs,misc,sw,cw,pw}.py -> P25
  • python/treams_rs/lattice.py -> P27
  • python/treams_rs/{ebcm,io,iterative,operators,_operators,_operator_objects,_array,_bases,_lattice,_material,_validation,_polarization,_modes}.py -> P28
  • python/treams_rs/{_tmatrix,_smatrix,_waves,_cluster,_periodic,_results,_upstream,init,diff}.py -> P30
  • python/treams_rs/{advect,jax,torch,testing,_records}.py, python/treams_rs/_framework*.py, python/treams_rs/_native.pyi -> P32
  • python/treams_rs/_catalog.py, main.py -> none (name it; the catalog renders the reference)
  • history wording in comments anywhere -> also D18 (mention both if a docstring package owns the file)

Return a concise Markdown section "## Docstrings and comments against the writing style" with: a per-file count table of VJP/jargon/meta hits (| File | VJP | jargon | meta | Owner |), then a findings table | File:line | Text (short quote) | Problem | Suggested rewrite | Owner | for the ~40 most important verified instances. Verified findings only.

Docstrings and comments against the writing style

Scope: docstrings and # comments in python/treams_rs/*.py and _native.pyi. I pulled them out with tokenize, searched them case-insensitively, and read every hit in context. _native.pyi has no docstrings and only two comments. Physics uses are left out of the counts: EBCM "surface integral", "surface area", "enclosing surfaces", layer "boundaries" (_tmatrix.py:668,829), "Boundary points of [-n,n]^d" (lattice.py:562) and tensor "contracts" (diff.py:465, sw.py:88). The _catalog.py hits for "package" mean the Python package, not a work package, so they are not meta.

_fields.py is not in the owner map. It had no hits.

Cross-cutting finding (most important)

No module docstring defines record, context, pullback or cotangent. plan.md §4.1 says the treams_rs.diff module docstring must quote the definition verbatim. The actual docstring (diff.py:1) is one line: "Framework-neutral native operations; all pullbacks use the real Hermitian pairing." Yet _records.py:4 says that "the treams_rs.diff module docstring defines record, context, pullback and cotangent", which is false.

"VJP" (23 times in diff.py, 10 in advect.py) is never defined. diff.py also switches between "VJP returns …" and "pullback returns …" for the same thing.
